args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After deploying v2.3.1, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. v2.3.1 was also unhealthy as v2.3.1-rc in staging. We rolled checkout-api back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy and the error rate is about 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying, and check why it was promoted despite failing in staging.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and the service is healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Before the rollback:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an error rate of about 18%.
- **Version picked:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, and its test build (v2.3.1-rc) had already failed in staging.
- **After the rollback:** all three regions are on v2.3.0, health checks pass, and the error rate is about 0.2%.
- **Incident INC-0001 (SEV2):** it records the failure, the rollback and the result. It also lists two follow-ups: find out why v2.3.1 failed before redeploying it, and find out why it reached production after failing in staging.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
